summary: Focused regression retest of the book-history-btn overlay fix. Dealt with fast speed / stakes 1, passed through auction (West won), auto-played until first book completed, then clicked the bottom-left book-history-btn. The Book Replay modal now opens successfully, book-chip-1 exists, clicking a chip renders book-replay-detail with the 3 played cards (West/East/You), and close-history-btn closes the modal. No false BUSTED A LEAD trigger, no blank screen.
critical_code_review_comments: Regression fix verified: HandTray wrapper's pointer-events-none combined with the book-history-btn row being raised to z-40 correctly restores clickability of the bottom-left button without blocking card interactions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_3 had one MEDIUM issue: book-history-btn was overlapped by the player-hand container (z-30) and clicks were intercepted. iteration_4 confirms the fix works end-to-end: book-history-btn is visible with proper bounding box (x=142, y=749.5), receives click, opens book-replay-modal, shows chips (1-4), clicking book-chip-1 shows book-replay-detail with 3 cards (A♦ / J♦ / A♦ for book 1, West won +2), and close-history-btn closes the modal cleanly.
rca of the issue: Root cause (previous iteration): The .player-hand container had z-index 30 and spanned the full width including the bottom-left corner where the Book History button sits, intercepting pointer events. Fix applied by main agent: outer HandTray wrapper set to pointer-events-none so only the individual card containers (pointer-events-auto) capture clicks, and the book-history-btn row raised to z-40. Verified: clicking book-history-btn now reliably opens the BookReplayModal.
